school_name: 克萊蒙高等商學院 Clermont School of Business
cost_summary:
【中央公開介紹參考；年份／116適用性未確認】生活費：The living expenses including rent, food, other bills, can be 
estimated at around 610- 1050€ per month minimum depending on 
the student’s lifestyle and the type of accommodation rented 
During the first month students will need extra money for rent 
deposits, connecting electricity, gas, telephone and various other 
extras（ESC Clermont克萊蒙費朗高等商學院.pdf PDF，第1頁；https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_21NXsggFlaHJ3UDg32CzPV6MDuM3Ee9/view）
housing_summary:
【中央公開介紹參考；年份／116適用性未確認】住宿：It is not possible to reserve a room in a hall of residence. The school 
works with a partner called Moversia for the accommodation of the 
international students. This is a paying service which helps students 
to find accommodation. 
http://www.welcomeclermont.com/ 
NB : It is really difficult for someone who do not speak French and 
who do not know anybody who can be a guarantor to find an 
accommodation in France.（ESC Clermont克萊蒙費朗高等商學院.pdf PDF，第1頁；https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_21NXsggFlaHJ3UDg32CzPV6MDuM3Ee9/view）

school_name: 慕尼黑應用科技大學 Hochschule München University of Applied Sciences
cost_summary:
【中央公開介紹參考；年份／116適用性未確認】生活費：At MUAS exchange students must pay EURO 42 per semester (subject to 
change) which provides the administration of eating and accommodation 
facilities. The fee is obligatory. 
Around euro 850-1000 per month.（慕尼黑應用科學大學.pdf PDF，第1頁；https://drive.google.com/file/d/1HXmwetQhMyVPJXSf6lqZWdMJKKdX2WvV/view）
housing_summary:
【中央公開介紹參考；年份／116適用性未確認】住宿：Housing in Munich unfortunately is a major issue. We are only able to house 
about 50% to 60% of our incoming students in student residence halls (they 
are subsidized by the state and therefore only cost around 280 to 360 Euro). 
Since there is no fair way to distribute the rooms, we use a lottery system in 
order to assign them. Those who are not lucky need to find a room on the 
private market. Although we do assist students by handing out information 
on how to find affordable housing, it is up to the student to find 
accommodation. Private rooms are much more expensive (starting at around 
500 Euro in shared apartments) and students should also consider living in 
the suburbs or towns along the regional train lines.（慕尼黑應用科學大學.pdf PDF，第1頁；https://drive.google.com/file/d/1HXmwetQhMyVPJXSf6lqZWdMJKKdX2WvV/view）

student_guide_sections.title: 住宿參考
student_guide_sections.summary: 中央公開介紹之歷史或未標年參考；116適用性、金額與全部期限尚待核對。
points:
【中央公開介紹參考；年份／116適用性未確認】住宿：Housing in Munich unfortunately is a major issue. We are only able to house 
about 50% to 60% of our incoming students in student residence halls (they 
are subsidized by the state and therefore only cost around 280 to 360 Euro). 
Since there is no fair way to distribute the rooms, we use a lottery system in 
order to assign them. Those who are not lucky need to find a room on the 
private market. Although we do assist students by handing out information 
on how to find affordable housing, it is up to the student to find 
accommodation. Private rooms are much more expensive (starting at around 
500 Euro in shared apartments) and students should also consider living in 
the suburbs or towns along the regional train lines.（慕尼黑應用科學大學.pdf PDF，第1頁；https://drive.google.com/file/d/1HXmwetQhMyVPJXSf6lqZWdMJKKdX2WvV/view）

points:
【中央公開介紹參考；年份／116適用性未確認】保險：All students are responsible for their own insurance arrangements and we strong recommend t hat you take 
a comprehensive insurance for your stay in Finland. Before leaving your home country, please check your 
travel and health insurance. 
Students from outside the EU / EEA must have private insurance to cover the duration of the visa / 
residence permit and the Schengen area before they enter Finland. The insurance must cover the treatment 
and health care provided by municipal health care services, cases of illness or accident, and include travel 
costs to home country as well as liability insurance. The health insurance must cover the costs of medical 
care up to 100,000 Euros.（LAB應用科技大學.pdf PDF，第1頁；https://drive.google.com/file/d/12_wfH5UxugCdNTkLCdEyZBZHRrXSoa8U/view）

student_guide_sections.summary: 中央公開介紹之歷史或未標年參考；116適用性、金額與全部期限尚待核對。
points:
【中央公開介紹參考；年份／116適用性未確認】簽證：Students coming from EU countries do not need visa. Other international students 
can get information about visa application procedure at the Czech embassies or 
consulates in their home countries or they can consult the website of the Ministry of 
Foreign Affairs of the Czech Republic. To be able to get the visa confirmed after your 
arrival at Immigration department, you must be insured for the whole period of your 
stay. We recommend you to administrate the health insurance in your country before 
departure. If you need VISA, ask at the Czech Embassy/Consulate in your home 
country about procedure; remember than you need the forms from us and Visa 
applications should be submitted to the Embassy at least 60 days before the planned 
date of departure. It is not possible to apply for the visa in the Czech Republic.（布爾諾理工大學.pdf PDF，第1頁；https://drive.google.com/file/d/19_r844eDJUSvpbBQ5_VliZCKh3YAdaWK/view）
student_guide_sections.caution: 不要用舊金額／未標年文件作為2027–2028保證；請看原始來源的方案、校區與日期。

school_name: 曼尼托巴大學 University of Manitoba
cost_summary: 【外校AY2027–2028資訊表；2026/9修訂。中央116是否提名此校仍待10/12名單。】交換生免Manitoba學費，仍繳中央學雜費；外校學生組織等約CAD150／學期，課程另可能有實習／實驗／書本CAD100–200／門。
housing_summary: 【外校AY2027–2028資訊表；2026/9修訂。中央116是否提名此校仍待10/12名單。】宿舍建議及早申請，Fall申請4/1開放、Winter 5/1開放；房型及meal plan費用各異，未承諾保證分配或最終住宿截止。
campus_life_summary:
【外校AY2027–2028資訊表；2026/9修訂。中央116是否提名此校仍待10/12名單。】抵達前參加線上orientation，接收校方報到資訊；Buddy資源可供認識校園。不可用約略開學月份決定機票。
【外校AY2027–2028資訊表；2026/9修訂。中央116是否提名此校仍待10/12名單。】不開放Architecture、Education、Engineering、Health Sciences及Asper Business；Computer Science 1000–4000全部不開放，Psychology／English honours亦限制。
【外校AY2027–2028資訊表；2026/9修訂。中央116是否提名此校仍待10/12名單。】Law僅可供已有高年級法學背景者；Music、Social Work等是否允許依課程及容量核對。
【外校AY2027–2028資訊表；2026/9修訂。中央116是否提名此校仍待10/12名單。】Fall學期9–12月；Winter 1–4月；2027–28精確校曆尚未定，orientation約9月初／1月初。

format）
